WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c."segment",
        c."currency",
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym."date" LIKE '2012%' THEN ym."consumption"::REAL ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym."date" LIKE '2013%' THEN ym."consumption"::REAL ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM
        "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN
        "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
    WHERE
        c."currency" = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY
        c."segment", c."currency"
),
percentage_changes AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        "currency",
        consumption_2012,
        consumption_2013,
        CASE
            WHEN consumption_2012 = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ((consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) / consumption_2012) * 100
        END AS percentage_increase
    FROM
        yearly_consumption
    WHERE
        consumption_2013 > 0
)
SELECT
    "segment",
    "currency",
    percentage_increase
FROM
    percentage_changes
WHERE
    percentage_increase IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    percentage_increase DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

UNION ALL

SELECT
    "segment",
    "currency",
    percentage_increase
FROM
    percentage_changes
WHERE
    percentage_increase IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    percentage_increase ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;
